verdict.rationale: Gecko is an AI security agent, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows the reverse role: Gecko publishes its own MCP server that outside AI tools connect to. Nothing documents Gecko acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party servers and uses their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
